propositions: _fold_heads currently merges bundle heads into the checked-out worktree HEAD, making the heal result dependent on the current branch, forcing a refusal guard that prevents healing off-branch or detached-HEAD trackers
The heal mechanism should use git merge-tree and commit-tree to fold heads into the published ref tip without touching the worktree, allowing healing regardless of checked-out branch
The merge=ours driver policy for .bridge_state files is not tested and must be preserved when replacing git merge with merge-tree
A tracker with a dirty worktree on the checked-out ref should refuse early before downloading bundles, but trackers on other branches or detached HEAD should heal successfully
After an off-branch heal, the checked-out branch and worktree must remain unchanged; after an on-branch heal, index and worktree must be consistent with the moved ref
